title: RIDGE: State-Conditioned Reward Blending for Behavioral Coverage in Deep RL Game Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.05601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A deep RL agent trained on a fixed persona reward plays one way: an Explorer keeps exploring while starving, a Survivor hoards on an empty map. Since each persona fixes its own reward, automated playtesting trains N agents for N styles. Changing reward composition mid-episode runs into the switching-stability dilemma: PPO degrades under non-stationary rewards. We present RIDGE, a single-agent architecture that sidesteps the dilemma with two design choices: a state-conditioned blender that computes softmax-normalized sigmoid weights from slow-moving state variables, and a multi-head critic that trains one value head per persona on its own stationary signal. On Crafter with four personas, one \ridge agent acquires both branches of the wood-tier crafting/combat split that no fixed-persona baseline solves jointly, and a sharpness ablation confirms state-conditioning drives the gain. translated_title: RIDGE：面向深度强化学习游戏智能体行为覆盖的状态条件奖励混合方法
translated_abstract: 在固定“人格”奖励上训练的深度强化学习智能体只会以一种方式行事：探索者在饥饿时仍继续探索，幸存者在空地图上囤积资源。由于每种人格都固定了自身的奖励，自动化游戏测试需要为 N 种风格训练 N 个智能体。而在回合中途改变奖励组成则会陷入“切换-稳定性”两难：PPO 在非平稳奖励下会发生性能退化。我们提出 RIDGE，一种通过两个设计选择规避该两难问题的单智能体架构：一是状态条件混合器，从缓慢变化的状态变量计算出经 softmax 归一化的 sigmoid 权重；二是多头评论家，为每个人格在其自身的平稳信号上分别训练一个价值头。在包含四种人格的 Crafter 环境中，单个 RIDGE 智能体同时掌握了木器级别制作/战斗分支的两条路径，而没有任何固定人格基线能够同时解决这两者；锐度消融实验证实状态条件化是性能提升的关键。我们将这些结果定位为混合方法能力的演示。
tldr: RIDGE 通过状态条件奖励混合器和多头评论家架构，让单个深度强化学习游戏智能体同时掌握多种行为风格，从而规避了 PPO 在非平稳奖励下的性能退化问题。
en_tdlr: RIDGE enables a single deep RL game agent to master multiple behavior styles via a state-conditioned reward blender and a multi-head critic, sidestepping PPO's degradation under non-stationary rewards.
